main.description: An organizer-authored profile for a person, project, or other contributor to one event.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this contributor record was created.

description.description: The organizer-authored public description of this contributor for this event.

event.description: The DID-based record URI of the events.openmusic.event this contributor participated in.

links.description: Public links for this event contributor. Array order is the organizer's preferred display order.

media.description: Media attached to this event contributor. Array order is the organizer's preferred display order.

name.description: The organizer-owned display name for this event contributor.

roles.description: Ordered event-wide roles. Array order is the organizer's preferred display order.

items.description: A known event-wide contribution category. Other string values may be used by extensions.

source.description: A pinned DID-authored profile record used as provenance when hydrating this organizer-owned snapshot.

subject.description: The stable DID the organizer asserts is represented by this event profile. This assertion is not confirmation by that account.
